comments.body: So if I am correct then this header was already supported. Perhaps the ticket should just be to remove the old header?
I've adde a commit to remove the outdated EmbedResources Prefer header: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1290/commits/ef6e3ccf120bdc6c1ff36679db7cdccd689633b9.

The integration tests seems redundant and I think it's safe to remove them. I've changed it to use EMBED_CONTAINED in FedoraVersionsIT.java: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1290/commits/5a0264758b6b9102553e56751402f9dec3a7ac0e.

renderedFields.description:
Change the EmbedResources URI in Prefer header from http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#EmbedResources
to the one defined in the spec (http://www.w3.org/ns/oa#PreferContainedDescriptions).

c.f. section 3.2.1 : https://fcrepo.github.io/fcrepo-specification/#additional-prefer-values
